insights.summary: Three slides from Vivid's June 2026 investor presentation, posted by an investor on X on 13 Jul 2026 (the full deck isn't on NSE or Screener). They list its OEM partnerships (ABB, Hitachi, Siemens, Lauritz Knudsen) and accreditations, and give the new Ambernath plant's commercial operations as end of August 2026, with Phase 1 capacity of 14,300 LV and 700 MV verticals a year and 600+ staff. The September deck later moved the start to end-October.
